Deluxe Smart Swing Turnstile

Construction: SUS304 Stainless Steel, 1.5mm thickness
Reliability: MTBF ≥ 8 million cycles
Premium access control for high-traffic public areas; SUS304 stainless steel with 1.5mm thickness; MTBF ≥ 8 million cycles; wide transit width (≤110cm) with triple anti-pinch safety.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The Deluxe Smart Swing Turnstile is constructed from premium SUS304 stainless steel with a robust 1.5mm thickness. Utilizing high-precision laser cutting technology, it features a sleek and clean exterior free from common defects such as burrs, scratches, or sharp edges. The system is driven by a brushless DC motor and a specialized anti-collision core, boasting a Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) of over 8 million cycles. It supports a wide transit width of up to 110cm and includes a triple anti-pinch mechanism (mechanical, current, and electronic) to ensure maximum pedestrian safety. With integrated LED atmospheric lighting, custom voice prompts, and full fire linkage support, it represents a state-of-the-art solution for professional access control in high-traffic commercial and public environments.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Features

  • SUS304 Architectural Chassis: utilizes thickened aerospace-grade stainless steel with seamless laser welding for superior rigidity and saltwater corrosion resistance.
  • Rapid Access Dynamics: high-torque brushless motors allow for a sub-0.8s response time, optimizing pedestrian flow during peak hours in high-density corporate buildings.
  • Holistic Personnel Safety: combines infrared curtain anti-pinch technology with mechanical torque-limiting and full fire-safety signal integration for reliable emergency release.
  • Security Intelligence: features active IR sensors to detect unauthorized tailgating with intervals as small as 100mm, triggering automated voice deterrents and forensic logging.
  • Premium Visual Guidance: features soft-glow tri-color LED pillars on the top cap for intuitive green/red/amber status signaling, elevating the aesthetic of any lobby.
  • Engineered Longevity: tested for 8 million cycles MTBF with an onboard self-check system to alert technicians of maintenance needs proactively.

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
Chassis Thickness1.5mm SUS304 Stainless Steel shell
Passage WidthSupports widths up to 110 cm
Drive SystemBrushless DC motor with helical anti-collision drive core
DurabilityMTBF ≥ 8 million cycles; smooth acceleration/deceleration control
Safety SystemsTriple anti-pinch protection (Mechanical/Current/Optical); Anti-tailgate logic
Opening SpeedAdjustable in 10 steps; ≥0.8s minimum
EmergencyFire alarm linkage (Auto-open) and power-failure free-swing mode
Human InteractionIntegrated LED passage indicators, atmospheric lights, and customized voice feedback
Industrial StandardsPrecision laser cutting; IP-rated waterproof and dustproof treatment
Operation NoiseSmooth operation noise ≤ 65dB
Dimensions1400mm * 180mm * 1000mm
